limits: Timings, base damage, guard height and the2H anti-air flag follow the extracted source. Range, physical boxes, power, stun, pushback and combo rules remain existing engine adaptations. No full-kit, balancing or lore-fidelity certification is claimed.
The18 actions reuse admitted V100/V59 drawings;108 phase clips are not108 new drawings. Supplied costumes and other characters retain their existing behavior.

Browser journeys use fresh browser storage and public local-versus controls, without campaign/actor injection. Contact/guard damage contracts are covered by model tests; these separated-actor image journeys mainly exercise whiffs.

Static capture inspection cannot establish motion continuity, fine anatomical detail, full lore fidelity or physical mobile touch behavior. The390px viewport remains letterboxed and its fighters are small.
The browser costume matrix covers one supplied appearance per fighter in both directions plus2 mixed opt-in fights. It does not certify new costume animations.

Read-only expected-pivot measurement includes the renderer’s bounded native-alpha contact offset; tolerance is unchanged. The raw-pivot-assumption run is retained separately and excluded from this proof.
